items.en: ICEYE radar satellite image shows Russian Krasukha-2 electronic warfare system in Kaliningrad region
items.nl: Radarsatellietbeeld van ICEYE toont Russisch Krasukha-2-systeem voor elektronische oorlogvoering in de regio Kaliningrad
items.sEn: The Finnish company ICEYE has released a synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite image of a Russian Krasukha-2 electronic warfare system deployed in Russia's Kaliningrad exclave, Militarnyi reports.
